(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define start (first (find-color g 2)))
    (define goal (first (find-color g 3)))
    (define keys (find-color g 4))
    (define doors (find-color g 5))
    (define walls (find-color g 8))
    (define queue (list (list (first start) (second start) #f)))
    (define prev (make-hash))
    (define goal-state #f)
    (hash-set! prev (first queue) #f)
    (define (search)
      (unless (or (empty? queue) goal-state)
        (let* ((cur (first queue))
               (r (first cur))
               (c (second cur))
               (has-key (third cur)))
          (set! queue (rest queue))
          (if (and (= r (first goal)) (= c (second goal)))
              (set! goal-state cur)
              (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                (let* ((nr (+ r (first d)))
                       (nc (+ c (second d)))
                       (new-key (or has-key (member (list nr nc) keys)))
                       (st (list nr nc new-key)))
                  (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                             (not (member (list nr nc) walls))
                             (or new-key (not (member (list nr nc) doors)))
                             (not (hash-has-key? prev st)))
                    (hash-set! prev st cur)
                    (set! queue (append queue (list st)))))))
          (search))))
    (search)
    (define path
      (if goal-state
          (let rebuild ([cur goal-state] [acc (list)])
            (if (eq? cur #f)
                acc
                (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons (list (first cur) (second cur)) acc))))
          (list)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list path)])
      (let ((v (at out (first p) (second p))))
        (if (member v (list 2 3 4 5 8))
            out
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 7))))))
